_meta.name: MiniMax H3 reference-to-video (alt mode)
_meta.purpose: Single-shot overhead unboxing with native stereo ASMR audio. Feed box plates + product stills as Image 1…N. H3 Max 768P / 6s is the studio default.

inputs.10..14.image: Reference stills (box lid, open nest, product angles)
inputs.20.model: MiniMax H3 | MiniMax H3 Max (string; DynamicCombo option)

inputs.model.prompt: Locked 90-degree overhead unboxing, one continuous shot, 9:16, no cuts. Image 1 is the sealed unbranded box on a pale oak desk. Image 2 is the open box with the product nested in the insert. Image 3 is the product identity — match its shape, glaze, and color exactly. Bare adult hands only, no face, no torso. Sequence: sealed box → tape peel → lid opens to the nested product → two hands lift and slowly rotate the product → set it on the desk beside the open box. Audio is native ASMR: close-mic kraft paper, tape, ceramic tap, quiet room. No music, no voiceover, no logos.
